function inspect(value: object, showHidden = false) {
  try {
    console.dir(value, { getters: true, showHidden });
  } catch (error) {
    console.log("caught", String(error));
  }
}

const own: { readonly first: number; later?: number } = {
  get first() { delete own.later; return 1; },
  later: 2,
};
inspect(own);

const hidden: { first?: number; later?: number } = {};
Object.defineProperty(hidden, "first", { get() { delete hidden.later; return 1; } });
Object.defineProperty(hidden, "later", { configurable: true, value: 2 });
inspect(hidden, true);

const inherited: { first?: number; later?: number } = {
  get first() { delete inherited.later; return 1; },
  later: 2,
};
inspect(Object.create(inherited), true);

const proto: { later?: number } = { later: 2 };
const removesInherited = Object.create(proto);
Object.defineProperty(removesInherited, "first", {
  enumerable: true,
  get() { console.log("own getter"); delete proto.later; return 1; },
});
inspect(removesInherited, true);

const removesOwn = Object.create({
  get first() { console.log("prototype getter"); delete removesOwn.later; return (this as { marker: number }).marker; },
});
removesOwn.marker = 3;
removesOwn.later = 2;
inspect(removesOwn, true);

const redirected = { get first() { redirected.later = 7; return 1; }, later: 2 };
inspect(redirected);
